description: Search DinCat's library of ready-made question pages by keyword, in the user's language (e.g. 手取り, 永住, 敬語, JLPT, 年末調整, 到手, take-home pay). Returns up to 8 pages with links that open the question in DinCat's chat; if nothing matches, returns the shelves instead.

lang.description: Language of the reply and of the linked pages: ja = Japanese, zh = Simplified Chinese, en = English. Use the user's language.

name: search_library
title: Search the DinCat library
